notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
CONFIRMED by maintainer: 'WAYLAND_DISPLAY= ./target/release/kpdf' restores Wacom stylus
drawing, and is ALSO much less laggy than Wayland. Confirms the diagnosis -- winit has no
zwp_tablet_v2, so stylus events never reach egui on a Wayland session; under XWayland the
tablet arrives via XInput2 which winit supports. Nothing in kpdf.rs was at fault.

Priority dropped to P3: a working path exists today, real fix belongs upstream in winit.

OWED: document the workaround in kpdf module docs + README. 'My tablet does nothing' is an
unguessable dead end otherwise. Not done this session because src/bin/kpdf.rs was owned by a
running agent.

SEPARATE FINDING, do not fold in: X11 is 'much less laggy' than Wayland, same build, same
document. Distinct from the tablet gap -- that is a missing protocol, this is a perf gap on a
protocol we DO support. kpdf re-rasterises the whole page on any (page,dpi) change and
uploads a full texture; if the Wayland path also lacks damage tracking or hits a slower
present path it would feel exactly like this. Ours vs egui's vs winit's is UNKNOWN and
unmeasured. Cheap first step: measure frame times under both backends.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-08-28: the OWED documentation is DONE (commit 8970799) — the WAYLAND_DISPLAY= workaround is now in kpdf's module docs, near the top where someone whose tablet does nothing will actually find it. src/bin/kpdf.rs was no longer agent-owned.

Bead stays open: the real fix is still upstream in winit (zwp_tablet_v2), and this only documents the workaround. Now more pressing than P3 suggests — kpdf gained page add/delete (094f50e) aimed at lecturing with a tablet, so the Wayland gap blocks that whole workflow.

title: kpdf: Wacom stylus does not draw on Wayland -- winit lacks zwp_tablet_v2
